parts.text: An aeroplane of mass 2.5 × 10 5 kg lands with a speed of 62 m / s, on a horizontal runway at time t = 0. The aeroplane decelerates uniformly as it travels along the runway in a straight line until it reaches a speed of 6.0 m / s at t = 35 s.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) the deceleration of the aeroplane in the 35 s after it lands deceleration = ......................................................... [2]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) the resultant force acting on the aeroplane as it decelerates force = ......................................................... [2]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) the momentum of the aeroplane when its speed is 6.0 m / s. momentum = ......................................................... [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) At t = 35 s, the aeroplane stops decelerating and moves along the runway at a constant speed of 6.0 m / s for a further 15 s. On Fig. 1.1, sketch the shape of the graph for the distance travelled by the aeroplane along the runway between t = 0 and t = 50 s. You are not required to calculate distance values. Fig. 1.1 [3]

ms.label: 1(b)
ms.text:
curve of decreasing gradient from (0,0) to a point along dashed line
straight line of positive gradient after t = 35 s
gradient not zero at t = 35 s OR no change of gradient (at t = 35 s)

ms.label: 1(c)
ms.text: thermal energy AND in something specific (e.g. brakes / air / tyres) OR kinetic energy of air
